intro: A growing collection of summary notes, mathematical explorations and longer-form projects, all written in LaTeX and published directly to the web.

categories.label: Summary Notes
categories.description: Compact write-ups and worked mathematical ideas.

about: Axiomathic is built from a single LaTeX source: the same files generate the traditional PDF and this web edition. The visual layer is separate, so the mathematical source stays clean while the site can evolve independently.
